mechanism_fidelity.rationale: The mapping retains the source chain: several ordered records (physically secured units and separately recorded revision layers) formed under a partly shared time-varying influence (paper stock, ink, typewriter, pagination scheme, name forms, hand); sliding floating records against an anchored reference; a signal of one offset replicated across independently recorded feature classes and surviving hold-one-out; and an inference that places floating units and flags missing or inserted leaves. Every source limit has a named counterpart (local disturbance, weak shared signal, short or repetitive patterns, observer error, wrong anchors, insufficient overlap), and the mapping adds target-specific limits. Two warrants the source relies on are not secured in the target. First, crossdating needs records formed over overlapping periods; draft units may have been written end to end, in which case there is no overlapping pattern to match. Overlap is plausible where revision layers on one unit are contemporaneous with base text of another, or where units were worked concurrently, but the mapping itself notes that alternating work weakens the shared signal. Second, the source increment is a common annual unit across all records, which is what makes a one-increment displacement diagnostic of a missing ring. The mapping concedes leaves are not equal units of time, so leaf-count offsets and displacements are not commensurate across units unless that relation is established for the particular draft. The mapping does not hide this loss and bounds its claims accordingly, so preservation depends on those target conditions rather than failing outright.

target_fidelity.rationale: The inference is directed at the retained question. It yields a relative composition order of units and revision layers distinct from narrative order, a separate inference about a later assembly stage from unit-spanning features laid over units of differing composition position, and an explicit list of claims that stay uncertain (unplaced units, absolute dates without reliable anchors, lost witnesses, fair copies whose material dates the copying, intervals between positions). That covers both halves of the question, sequence of revision and assembly and residual uncertainty, as an explicitly bounded contribution: a ranked hypothesis held alongside alternatives. It does not substitute a different question. Because the packet supplies no evidence, no actual sequence is asserted; what is addressed is the form and bounds of the answer.

operational_coherence.rationale: Performing X (protocol-based feature recording completed before alignment, a reference built from anchored units only, sliding comparison, hold-one-out repetition, a separate series for unit-spanning features) would intelligibly produce Y (a single replicated offset, or else multiple or conflicting offsets), and the stopping rule prevents placement when the pattern is short, uniform or discordant. Whether Y warrants Z depends on empirical relations not established in the packet: that the recorded features change over composition time in a sequence shared across units; that units or layers overlap in time; that feature classes are sufficiently independent for hold-one-out agreement to count as replication (paper, ink and pagination can change together at a single event such as a move or a new notebook); and that chance agreement among few-state, author-controlled features is low enough for a unique offset to be evidential. The mapping states that no validated match threshold is assumed. The missing or inserted leaf inference from displacement does not follow from alignment alone given non-commensurate leaves; it is warranted only where the separately checked physical evidence is present, which the mapping requires. The chain is not circular as mapped, provided unit order was not originally set using the same features, a risk the mapping names.

unresolved_conditions: Temporal overlap: establish on the documents that at least some units or revision layers were inscribed over overlapping periods (for example, revision-layer ink or hand on one unit matching base-text features of another, or dated evidence of concurrent work). If units were written strictly end to end, the sliding-match operation has no overlapping pattern to align.

Shared time-varying signal: establish from anchored, dated units that paper stock, ink or instrument, pagination scheme, name forms and hand change in a consistent sequence over composition time and are not used concurrently or returned to. Check by tabulating feature states against independently dated leaves and correspondence.

Anchor existence and reliability: confirm that anchored units exist and that their dates are sound by verifying letter dates, provenance and whether any archival dating was itself derived from the same features. Without anchors, only a floating relative sequence is attainable.

Commensurability of increments: establish whether leaf position relates to composition time comparably across units, or confirm that matching rests only on the ordinal sequence of transitions. Until then, leaf-count offsets and one-leaf displacements cannot by themselves indicate missing or inserted leaves and must rest on the independent physical evidence (stubs, foliation gaps, broken textual continuity, offset ink).

Chance-match rate and independence of feature classes: estimate how often few-state feature sequences agree at wrong offsets, for example by aligning anchored units of known position against each other or by permutation of the recorded series, and test whether feature classes co-vary because of single events. No validated threshold for an acceptable match currently exists for this use.

Non-circular segmentation and physical order: confirm that the internal leaf order of each unit is secured by conjugacy, text running across page breaks or original foliation, not by the features later used for alignment, and that archival reordering or rebinding has not altered it. Check against collation records and conservation or provenance documentation.

Inscription versus composition: identify fair copies or recopied leaves, for instance by absence of currente calamo revision or by copying errors, so that material features are read as dating the inscription of the surviving leaf and not necessarily the composition of its text.
validity.rationale: No criterion fails. The mapping carries over the functional chain of crossdating, including anchored versus floating records, replication across independent series, detection of missing or extra increments, and a full set of limit counterparts. Its inference addresses the retained question about the sequence of revision and assembly and states which claims remain uncertain. Mechanism fidelity and operational coherence are conditional because the warrant from a replicated offset to a temporal placement depends on relations the packet does not establish (evidence is empty and the state is explicitly assumed): temporal overlap among units or layers, a shared time-varying material signal, reliable anchors, commensurability of leaves as increments, an acceptable chance-match rate with independent feature classes, and non-circular segmentation. Each is an identifiable measurement or empirical relation that could be established on the documents, and the mapping bounds its claims to a ranked hypothesis with bounded date ranges and a stopping rule. The status is therefore Conditional, not Valid or Invalid.

uncertainty: The packet supplies no evidence about the particular draft, so the existence of separable units, anchors, feature variation and overlap is unknown. The assessment treats these as the candidate's assumptions, not as facts.

It is unknown whether units were composed concurrently or sequentially. This determines whether the procedure is overlapping-pattern crossdating or reduces to ordering units by material features, which would carry a weaker warrant.

The rate of chance agreement for few-state, author-controlled features is unquantified, and no validated match threshold exists. How much evidential weight a unique offset carries is therefore uncertain.
The degree of independence among feature classes is unknown. Hold-one-out agreement may overstate replication if classes change together at single events.

The choice between 'addressed' and 'conditional' for target fidelity is a judgement call. The inference matches the question in form and bounds, but with no evidence supplied it yields no actual sequence.

Whether the limit on non-commensurate leaves amounts to a bounded weakening or a material loss of the source's increment-level warrant is arguable. It was assessed as conditional because the mapping discloses it and ties missing-leaf claims to independent physical evidence.
